item.text: Most quota checks, feature gates and workspace displays read the plan through the organization repository, which currently returns the stale workspace value. The limiter uses a separate plan map, and the trial sweep selects expired paid subscriptions without checking their status. I’ll make organization reads resolve the subscription plan, pass that plan to burst limits, and restrict expiry to trials.
